intro: Your plan with Clafina: what this month costs so far and is likely to cost by its end, what you owe, what you have used against what is included, and your invoices.
start: Read the cards at the top: this month so far, the projection and what you owe.
Read the meters, to see how much of what your plan includes you have used.
Open your latest invoice and check who it is billed to.

articles.title: Understand what this month will cost
articles.summary: See what the month would cost if it ended today, where it is heading, and what you have used of your plan.

steps.lead: Read the cards at the top.
steps.rest: This month so far, the projection and what you owe.
Each says in words how much is used of what is included.

steps.lead: Read If the month ended today
steps.rest: for what the month would cost now, item by item. It is an estimate, not an invoice.

tips: Projected is the month at its end if usage keeps its pace so far. Things like people who can sign in stay where they are.
Over means more used than the plan includes. Only the part over is charged.

articles.title: Change your plan or the features you pay for
articles.summary: An owner changes the plan or switches features on and off. You see what the change means before it is made.
before: Only an owner of the organisation can change the plan or the features.

steps.rest: and say why, if you want to. The drawer says what the change means for you.
to confirm, or Keep my plan.

steps.lead: For a feature, tick or untick it under Features,
steps.rest: with its price a month beside it, then press Save features.

articles.title: Tell Clafina you paid by bank transfer
articles.summary: Note the amount, the day and the reference on the invoice, so Clafina can match your transfer to it.

steps.lead: Press I have paid by transfer
steps.rest: and give the amount, the day and the bank reference.
Clafina is told in a Help case and matches your transfer to the invoice.

articles.after: The invoice lists your note under Paying this invoice. Nothing is marked paid until Clafina sees the money.
tips: Something on an invoice look wrong? Press Ask about this invoice and say which line and why. Clafina answers in Help and credits what was wrong.
Each line of an invoice says why it was charged, and Download PDF keeps a copy.
